description: Sextaris answers market questions with its own computed metrics: keyword demand scores and bands by country, US state and metro; rankings of the best geographies to target or enter; local-language vs English demand comparisons; and US ZIP-code affluence profiles built from Census data (median income, share of $200k+ households, wealth segments). Built for SEO, PPC, market-entry and local lead-gen research. Results are Sextaris indices and ranked verdicts, not raw data tables. Requires an existing Sextaris account with available credits.
